# Louiss Web Studio

> Louiss Web Studio is a web design and development studio based in Tangier, Morocco.
> It builds fast, modern, custom-coded websites for businesses across Morocco, with a
> focus on turning visitors into clients. Sites go from Figma design to live in under
> 7 days and are delivered in French, Arabic, and English.

## What we do

- Louiss Web Studio designs and develops custom websites for small and medium businesses in Morocco.
- Every website is custom-coded from scratch — no templates and no page builders.
- Websites are mobile-first and performance-optimized (target Google PageSpeed score 90+).
- Sites are built to convert: clear structure, strong calls to action, and WhatsApp integration on every page.
- Websites are multilingual (French, Arabic, English) with right-to-left support for Arabic.

## Services offered

- Website design (web design)
- Custom website development
- E-commerce websites
- Online booking / reservation systems
- On-page SEO (structured headings, meta tags, Open Graph, sitemap, page-speed optimization)
- Ongoing website maintenance and support

## Location and service area

- Based in Tangier (Tanger), Morocco.
- Serves clients across Morocco, including Tangier, Marrakech, Agadir, Casablanca, Fès, and Essaouira.

## Target clients / niches

- Restaurants and cafés
- Riads, hotels, and tourism operators
- Car rental agencies
- Dental practices and clinics (cabinets dentaires)
- Real estate and property rental businesses
- Local service businesses (roofing, moving companies, transfers, and similar)

## Pricing model

- Fixed-price packages quoted in Moroccan dirham (MAD / DH), not hourly billing.
- Three main packages: Starter Website, Business Website, and Premium Website.
- Entry-level websites start around 2,500 MAD; larger multi-page and custom booking projects are priced higher.
- A free personalized demo of the future website is provided before any payment or commitment.

## Key differentiators

- From Figma design to live website in under 7 days for standard projects.
- 100% custom-coded websites — no templates, no page builders.
- Free personalized demo before the client pays anything.
- 2 rounds of revisions included on every project.
- 30 days of free post-launch support, with optional monthly maintenance packages.
- Built-in WhatsApp contact for fast lead conversion.

## Selected work

- Adventure Keys — travel and tourism website
- Agadir Transfer — airport transfer booking website
- Supreme Toiture — roofing company lead-generation website
- Digiseo — SEO and digital marketing website
- El Majdoub Immobilier — real estate rental platform in Agadir
- Movexa — moving company website
